d: A small, youthful humanoid with deep cocoa brown skin, featuring a single amber-gold eye visible beneath a golden helmet. The figure has a compact build and wears a white, cream, and red ceremonial outfit consisting of a high-collared tunic with golden trim and a flowing white cape. A massive, ornate circular headdress in shades of red, orange, and forest green dominates the back, while a pointed golden helmet with a small orange crescent adorns the head. BODY COLOR: Deep cocoa brown LEGS: Plantigrade with human-style feet, wearing golden ankle guards with small bells.
